description: Annotated 'Q proof' collage arguing that a wristwatch photo posted by Q was taken inside the Oval Office. The centerpiece is a wide-angle photograph of the Oval Office with several men seated in armchairs and on sofas (decor the caption calls 'Regan Style', i.e. Reagan-era), overlaid with arrows and zoomed crops matching blurred reflections in the watch photo to the room's walls and door. A screenshot of Q drop No.5930643 (03/27/19) showing the watch image and the text 'Marker [2] Set. Q' is inset at bottom, with the large caption 'Q PROOF / Watch is in the Castle / Regan Style'. The people in the Oval Office photo are not identified in the image.
flags: Unverified claim: the collage's assertion that the watch photo was taken in the Oval Office is the creator's interpretation, not established fact
Seated figures in the Oval Office photograph are not identified
'Regan' is the image's own misspelling of Reagan

A screenshot of Q drop No.5930643 (03/27/19) with the watch image and the text 'Marker [2] Set. Q' sits at bottom left, beside the large caption 'Q PROOF / Watch is in the Castle'.

description: Screenshot of Q drop 3178 dated 25 Mar 2019, rendered in a dark aggregator-app style with the headline 'The Only Way to Regain Trust in Government Is to Provide Truth, Transparency and Prosecution'. The drop claims the only way to regain the trust of the American people is truth, transparency, and prosecution of those who took part in what it calls an illegal manufactured '[ATTEMPTED COUP]' to take down the President, and closes with '[1] OPENS THE DOOR. THE GREAT AWAKENING.' These are the drop's claims, not established fact.
